APPENDIX B – BUILDING NUMBERS AND ESTIMATED SQUARE FOOTAGES

B.1 The following list of buildings, estimated square footages and frequencies of service establishes the “cleaning area” for this contract. Square footages are estimates of the areas to be cleaned and are taken from base real property records and the floor plans furnished as Attachment 4. Modifications for a price increase or decrease to the contract shall only be made when the overall identified cleaning area square footage in this Appendix increases or decreases, or a frequency of cleaning service changes.

B.2 Frequency codes: 5X/WK – Monday through Friday; 3X/WK – Monday, Wednesday, Friday; 2X/WK – Tuesday and Thursday; 1X/WK – once per week on a day set by the COR; UTA – once on each Unit Training Assembly (drill) weekend, normally one weekend per month.
